cues.text: Most AI gives you a reply. Aselius gives you the work.
cues.spoken: Most AI gives you a reply. Aselius gives you the work.

cues.text: Aselius is agentic infrastructure software, run by specialized Rivine engines. Every result is a real file you can inspect, edit and export.
cues.spoken: Aselius is agentic infrastructure software, run by specialized Rivine engines. Every result is a real file you can inspect, edit and export.

cues.text: Everything lives in one sidebar: your workspaces, Connector, Selius, Automations, Observability, Credits and Manage Teams.
cues.spoken: Everything lives in one sidebar: your workspaces, Connector, Selius, Automations, Observability, Credits and Manage Teams.

cues.text: Inside a workspace, Taskspace is where work happens: the conversation on the left, the Preview Panel on the right.
cues.spoken: Inside a workspace, Taskspace is where work happens: the conversation on the left, the Preview Panel on the right.

cues.text: Choose the Rivine engine for the job: TaskForce, Research, Code, Cicero, Creative, Confluence, Assist or Browse. The engine you pick is the engine that runs.
cues.spoken: Choose the Rivine engine for the job: TaskForce, Research, Code, Cicero, Creative, Confluence, Assist or Browse. The engine you pick is the engine that runs.

cues.text: Set the engine and its specialty, then send. Or start from an Agent Note that already has both.
cues.spoken: Set the engine and its specialty, then send. Or start from an Agent Note that already has both.

cues.text: Every step shows as it happens. Stop it any time; the trail stays with the thread.
cues.spoken: Every step shows as it happens. Stop it any time; the trail stays with the thread.

cues.text: Before it acts in your apps, you approve the exact action. Nothing runs until you do.
cues.spoken: Before it acts in your apps, you approve the exact action. Nothing runs until you do.

cues.text: If it needs you, it asks one question and waits.

cues.text: One turn. A whole launch kit: documents, data, media and the app, each one a real file.
cues.spoken: One turn. A whole launch kit: documents, data, media and the app, each one a real file.

cues.text: Open any file exactly as generated: Word as pages, Excel as a grid, decks slide by slide.

cues.text: Edit with Rivine Assist. Then save, publish or export.

cues.text: Publish a snapshot with its own access code. Later edits stay private until you update it.
